text: The volume of rubbish thrown away by ordinary households has risen sharply in recent decades, placing heavy pressure on landfill sites and city budgets. This essay will argue that the problem is driven mainly by excessive packaging and a culture of disposable products, and that it can be reduced through a combination of regulation and changes in consumer habits.

The first major cause is the way goods are packaged and sold. Supermarkets wrap even fruit and vegetables in plastic, and online shopping means that a single order often arrives in several layers of cardboard and bubble wrap. A second cause is the growing preference for cheap, short-lived products. Clothes, electronic devices and furniture are now so inexpensive that people tend to replace them rather than repair them, with the result that items which could last for years end up in the bin after a few months.

To tackle these causes, governments should first put pressure on producers. For example, laws could require companies to use recyclable packaging or pay a fee for every tonne of non-recyclable material they sell, which would give them a strong financial reason to use less. At the same time, local authorities can make responsible behaviour easier for residents by providing separate bins for different materials and charging households according to the amount of general waste they produce. Where such schemes have been introduced, the amount of rubbish sent to landfill has often fallen considerably.

In conclusion, household waste is growing largely because of unnecessary packaging and the habit of replacing rather than repairing goods. Making producers responsible for their packaging and rewarding residents who recycle are, in my opinion, the most effective ways to reverse this trend.

note.en: A thesis with a plan: causes and solutions in one sentence.
note.kk: Жоспары бар тезис: себептер мен шешімдер бір сөйлемде.
note.ru: Тезис с планом: причины и решения одной фразой.

note.en: Opens the first cause — a clear paragraph structure.
note.kk: Бірінші себепті ашады — абзацтың анық құрылымы.
note.ru: Открывает первую причину — чёткая структура абзаца.

note.en: The second cause in the same paragraph.
note.ru: Вторая причина в том же абзаце.

note.en: Shows the result of the throwaway habit.
Links the solutions paragraph to the causes.
Makes the measure for producers concrete.
Explains why the measure would work.
Adds a second measure running alongside the first.
note.kk: Біріншісімен қатар жүретін екінші шараны қосады.

note.en: Sums up the causes in one phrase.

strengths.en: The cause is shown through a familiar picture rather than named abstractly, which makes it convincing.
strengths.kk: Себеп абстрактілі аталмаған, таныс көрініспен көрсетілген — дәлелге сену оңайырақ.
strengths.ru: Причина не названа абстрактно, а показана на знакомой картинке — так проще поверить доводу.
strengths.example: a single order often arrives in several layers of cardboard and bubble wrap

strengths.en: Each measure targets a specific cause rather than “the environment” in general — strong Task Response.
strengths.kk: Әр шара «жалпы экологияға» емес, нақты себепке бағытталған — бұл күшті Task Response.
strengths.ru: Каждая мера направлена на конкретную причину, а не «вообще на экологию» — это сильный Task Response.
strengths.example: laws could require companies to use recyclable packaging

strengths.en: Topic words in natural combinations — Lexical Resource 7+.
strengths.kk: Тақырып сөздері табиғи тіркестерде — Lexical Resource 7+.
strengths.ru: Слова темы в естественных сочетаниях — Lexical Resource 7+.
strengths.example: placing heavy pressure on landfill sites and city budgets

strengths.en: The question has two parts — causes and measures — and both get their own paragraph and appear in the conclusion.
strengths.kk: Сұрақта екі бөлік бар — себептер мен шаралар, — екеуі де жеке абзацтарда ашылып, қорытындыда жинақталған.
strengths.ru: В вопросе две части — причины и меры, — и обе раскрыты в отдельных абзацах и собраны в выводе.
strengths.example: household waste is growing largely because of unnecessary packaging

note.en: Introduction: the problem in the writer’s own words and a thesis that answers both parts — causes and measures.
note.kk: Кіріспе: мәселе өз сөзімен және сұрақтың екі бөлігіне — себептер мен шараларға бірден жауап беретін тезис.
note.ru: Введение: проблема своими словами и тезис, который сразу отвечает на обе части вопроса — причины и меры.

note.en: The causes paragraph: two causes, each with a real-life example and a consequence.
note.kk: Себептер туралы абзац: екі себеп, әрқайсысында өмірден мысал және салдар.
note.ru: Абзац о причинах: две причины, у каждой — пример из жизни и следствие.

note.en: The solutions paragraph: each measure matches a cause — packaging → producers, habits → residents.
note.kk: Шешімдер туралы абзац: әр шешім өз себебіне жауап береді — орама → өндірушілер, әдеттер → тұрғындар.
note.ru: Абзац о решениях: каждое решение отвечает на свою причину — упаковка → производители, привычки → жители.

note.en: The conclusion briefly restates the causes and solutions without new ideas.
note.kk: Қорытынды себептер мен шешімдерді жаңа ой қоспай қысқаша қайталайды.
note.ru: Вывод коротко повторяет причины и решения, не добавляя новых идей.
